statements.subject: session
statements.description: a secure dialog begins after Bob replies authenticating himself to Carol

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Carol's UA SHOULD initiate a TLS connection with the biloxi proxy directly when she wishes to send an INVITE, and when her UA receives a certificate from the biloxi proxy, it SHOULD be verified normally before she passes her INVITE across the TLS connection
actions: initiate TLS connection with biloxi proxy

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The biloxi proxy MAY have a strict policy that precludes it from even bothering to challenge requests that do not have biloxi.com in the domainname portion of the From header field - it treats these users as unauthenticated
statements.trigger: request received without biloxi.com domain in From header

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The biloxi proxy has a policy for Bob that all non-authenticated requests should be redirected to the appropriate contact address registered against 'bob@biloxi.com'
actions: send redirection response with registered contact address

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Carol SHOULD then establish a TCP connection with the designated address and send a new INVITE with a Request-URI containing the received contact address (recomputing the signature in the body as the request is readied)
actions: establish TCP connection with designated contact address
send new INVITE with contact address as Request-URI

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Bob receives the INVITE, his UA inspects and recognizes the From header field and subsequently matches a locally cached certificate with the one presented in the signature of the body of the INVITE; he replies in similar fashion, authenticating himself to Carol, and a secure dialog begins
statements.trigger: INVITE received with matching signature certificate
actions: match locally cached certificate against body signature
